items.headline: One less errand. One freshly groomed dog.
items.caption:
Some appointments require a drive across town. Your dog’s grooming doesn’t have to.

We bring the salon to your home in the Tri-Cities. Text your ZIP code and your dog’s breed to (509) 591-5913 to ask about availability.
